# grill-me-with-spec 1.0.3 Changelog

- Updated SKILL.md to simplify and streamline documentation; retained all essential instructions, but removed duplicated and verbose guidance.
- Removed deprecated file `skill-card.md` to reduce redundancy and potential confusion.
- No logic or runtime changes; documentation only.

- Updated version to 1.1.1 in SKILL.md.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core logic or instructions; maintenance and metadata update only.

- Expanded the "When to Use" section to explicitly include cases where the skill is mentioned in English or Portuguese by name.
- Updated a reference in "When NOT to Use" from `/tdd-spec` to `/execute-tdd-spec`.
- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.

- Initial public release of the "grill-me-with-spec" skill.
- Guides users (in Portuguese) through rigorous feature/spec SDD creation before any implementation.
- Builds a design decision tree, asking all relevant questions step-by-step, and gathers facts using sub-agents when possible.
- Outputs a complete SPEC file (`.specs/SPEC-{YYYYMMDD}-{feature}.md`) following the SDD template with all mandatory sections.
- Clear separation: Never used for implementation, only for requirement gathering and specification drafting.
